name: The Empire
canon: almost 180 years old; made by the great Law Giver of the lost city of jewels; built on tribute and conquest for the lady of the skies; the dynasty's hold is about to break — drought; eastern raids and migrations; the southern rebellion

name: The Neo Sumerian Rebellion
canon: the seer from the city of Ur — the mysterious sage of the swamps — seeks to unite the southern city states; push back the barbarians; fix the drought; rebirth Sumerian culture

name: The Barbarians
canon: eastern mountain people turned warrior people by a new form of thought; tribal and scattered; bound loosely by survival of the breaking — new lands in the west

name: The Brotherhood of the Serpent
canon: Ante-Diluvian priestly secret order; preserve balance and the natural law; works in the background; can only be met by the worthy; describes the Empire's deity as a demonic entity

name: The Retributors of Utu
canon: guild of paladins headquartered at the City of the Sun

name: The dead cult
canon: the biggest ancestor and underworld cult; City of the Dead / Gravestone (whether these are one city or two is OPEN — game-design §11.7)

name: The cult of the Sky Father
canon: centered on the sacred hill at the City of the Sky

name: The eastern barbarian alliance
canon: the mighty warchief's alliance; City of the Warrior Spirit

canon: reign alone in the South (regions:south plan 2)
